name: Construction
description: Base schema for the Construction domain.

ConstructionInformationModel.label: Construction Information Model
ConstructionInformationModel.description: A container for persisting constr:ConstructionItem instances.

ConstructionInformationPartition.label: Construction Information Partition
ConstructionInformationPartition.description: A constr:ConstructionInformationPartition element indicates that there is a construction modeling perspective within the overall information hierarchy. A constr:ConstructionInformationPartition is always parented to a bis:Subject and broken down by a constr:ConstructionInformationModel.

StationRange.label: Station Range
StationRange.description: Struct to define a station range.

ConstructionDetailingElement.label: Construction Detailing Element
ConstructionDetailingElement.description: Identifies a portion of real-world physical object that is suitable for construction.

properties.name: StationRange
properties.description: Well-known location of the element defined by the station range.
properties.label: Station Range

properties.name: LengthOfSlice
properties.description: Length of an element produced by slice operation.
properties.label: Length of Slice

WorkAreaDetailingElement.label: Work Area Detailing Element
WorkAreaDetailingElement.description: Identifies a portion of real-world physical object that got split because it crossed construction work area boundary.

ConstructionDetailingElementSplitsGeomet.description: Relationship enabling splitup of bis:GeometricElement3d elements into the smaller pieces.

ConstructionItem.label: Construction Item
ConstructionItem.description: Defines a constructible component which may or may not be modeled in the 3D model.

ConstructionItemConstructsGeometricEleme.description: Relates constr:ConstructionItem to the real world entities (or their split up pieces modeled as constr:ConstructionDetailingElement elements) it constructs.

ConstructionWorkArea.label: Construction Work Area
ConstructionWorkArea.description: Represents geographically identifiable area which encompasses all disciplines that will execute work within that area.

ElementBelongsToConstructionWorkArea.description: Relates a bis:Element to the constr:ConstructionWorkArea that it belongs to.

GenericConstructionObject.label: Construction Object
GenericConstructionObject.description: Represents a generic object used during construction

CostCode.label: Cost Code
CostCode.description: The aspect used to store Cost Code assignments to constr:ConstructionItem elements.

properties.name: CodeId
properties.description: The Id of the Cost Code in Construction QTO service.
properties.label: Cost Code Id

ConstructionQuantity.label: Construction Quantity
ConstructionQuantity.description: The aspect used to store construction quantity data for constr:ConstructionItem elements.

properties.name: CostCodeId
properties.description: The Id of the Cost Code in Construction QTO service.
properties.label: Cost Code Id

properties.name: WorkStepCode
properties.description: Work Step Code for which the value is calculated.
properties.label: Work Step Code

properties.name: QuantityUnitName
properties.description: The fully qualified unit name (if it exists) used to persist the quantity value.
properties.label: Unit of Measure name

properties.name: QuantityUnitLabel
properties.description: The unit display label to use when showing the quantity value.
properties.label: Unit of Measure label

properties.name: JsonProperties
properties.description: A string property that users and/or applications can use to persist ad hoc JSON values.
properties.label: JSON Properties
